title: Saudian Keto Tagine Casserole
description: A rich and flavorful casserole originating from the Arabian region, adapted to fit a keto diet. This tagine-inspired dish is perfect for a satisfying keto meal.
instructions: Cut the Saudian casserole into 1-inch cubes.
In a large skillet, heat the funky sauce over medium heat. Add the Arabian spices and cook for 1 minute.
Add the casserole cubes to the skillet and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the casserole mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle the aerated cheese evenly over the casserole mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
